name: I_portrait_interlaced
notes: Portrait 480x852 (0.563:1) encoded as TRUE interlaced H.264 top-field-first: each output frame takes its top field from moment n and its bottom field from moment n+1, so combing is real and a deinterlacer must be used or the moving elements will look feathered. Tests (a) non-16:9 aspect handling, (b) field-order metadata and (c) vertically tall tiles. 22.000s, 4 shots. NOTE: 480x854 is NOT a legal size for interlaced H.264 4:2:0 - libx264 rejects it with 'height not divisible by 4 (480x854)'. 852 (213 macroblocks) is the nearest legal height, hence 480x852.
frame_notes: top and bottom fields come from consecutive moments
